scheme-problem.NAME_TWICE: Two variables are named "{{variable}}". Rename one of them: an element in the editor by its ID, a derived variable in coding.
scheme-problem.INVALID_SOURCE: "{{variable}}" has an invalid source: its ID appears twice, its name matches the ID of another variable, or it is set up as a variable without a value although it has one. Check the variable in coding and give it a unique name if needed.
scheme-problem.SOURCE_MISSING: A source of "{{variable}}" is missing: the base variable is no longer in the unit, or a source of the derivation does not exist. Select its sources again in coding, or delete the variable.

scheme-problem.ONLY_ONE_SOURCE: "{{variable}}" is derived from only one source. Add more sources in coding, or copy the value instead.
scheme-problem.VALUE_COPY_NOT_FROM_BASE: "{{variable}}" copies the value of a derived variable. Select a base variable as its source in coding.
scheme-problem.RULE_PARAMETER_COUNT_MISMATCH: In the coding of "{{variable}}", a rule has too many or too few parameters. Add or remove parameters of the rule.
scheme-problem.RULE_REGEX_INVALID: In the coding of "{{variable}}", the regular expression of a rule is invalid. Correct the expression in the rule.
scheme-problem.RULE_PARAMETER_INVALID: In the coding of "{{variable}}", a rule does not fit the value of the variable or has an invalid parameter. Correct the rule.
scheme-problem.RULE_NUMERIC_RANGE_INVALID: In the coding of "{{variable}}", a range rule has invalid limits: a limit is missing or not a number, or the lower one is above the upper one. Correct the limits in the rule.
scheme-problem.RULESET_VALUE_ARRAY_POS_INVALID: In the coding of "{{variable}}", a rule set names a position in the value that does not exist. Correct the position in the rule set.

scheme-problem-detail.SOURCE_MISSING_ELEMENT: "{{variable}}" codes an element that is no longer in the unit. Delete the variable in coding.
scheme-problem-detail.SOURCE_MISSING_NONE: No source variable is selected for "{{variable}}". In coding, select the source variables of "{{variable}}", or delete the variable.
scheme-problem-detail.SOURCE_MISSING_ONE: The source variable "{{source}}" of "{{variable}}" is not in the unit. In coding, select the source variables of "{{variable}}" again, or delete the variable.
scheme-problem-detail.SOURCE_MISSING_MANY: Source variables of "{{variable}}" are not in the unit: {{sources}}. In coding, select the source variables of "{{variable}}" again, or delete the variable.
scheme-problem-detail.MORE_THAN_ONE_SOURCE: "{{variable}}" copies a value but has several source variables: {{sources}}. Only one of the values is taken. In coding, select only one source variable for "{{variable}}", or choose another derivation if all of them are to count.
scheme-problem-detail.ONLY_ONE_SOURCE: "{{variable}}" is derived from "{{source}}" only. In coding, select the missing source variables for "{{variable}}", or choose to copy the value if only this one is meant.
scheme-problem-detail.VALUE_COPY_NOT_FROM_BASE: "{{variable}}" copies the value of the derived variable "{{source}}". In coding, select a base variable as the source variable of "{{variable}}".

codes.GEOGEBRA_NOT_LOADING: The GeoGebra package could not be loaded. It is missing from this studio or cannot be reached at the moment. The geometry elements of this unit therefore stay empty. Please contact your administrator.
codes.GEOGEBRA_TIMEOUT: A geometry element did not finish loading in time. Possible causes are a slow connection, an incomplete GeoGebra package or a faulty GeoGebra file. Reload the unit. If the error comes back, the GeoGebra file must be checked in the editor. If you cannot do that, contact your administrator.
codes.IMAGE_NOT_LOADING: An image of this unit cannot be shown. The image file is probably damaged. The image must be uploaded again in the editor.
codes.MEDIA_TIMEOUT: An audio or video file of this unit was not loaded in time. Possible causes are a very large file or a format the browser cannot play. Reload the unit. If the error comes back, the file must be checked in the editor.
codes.MEDIA_DURATION_ERROR: The length of an audio or video file cannot be determined. This happens, for example, with recordings made directly in the browser. The file must be saved in another format, such as MP3 or MP4, and uploaded again in the editor.
